about_the_game:
Neon Overdrive is a procedural generated, rogue-like, VR shooter set in an 80s-inspired Retro Futuristic Sci-Fi world. Fight your way through hordes of Exo Bots utilizing four unique character classes, special abilities and a variety of perk combinations.

Stack, mix, and match over 50 perks! Providing you with the tools to make ever run unique. From common stat buffs to major ability and gameplay shake ups, strategically stack your perks to craft your most devastating build.

The Overdrive Mechanic is a dynamic difficulty modifier that gives enemies new abilities, boosted stats, and an a brand new look!

Play to unlock 4 Unique Classes, each with their own Weapons and set of abilities. Master each class, complete class specific challenges for cosmetic rewards. Each class provides a new playstyle and an opportunity to craft new builds.

The Overdrive Mechanic is a dynamic difficulty modifier that gives enemies new abilities, boosted stats, and an a brand new look!

Procedurally Generated Levels, Dynamic Difficulty Scaling, Challenges , and Cosmetic Reward Systems all keep you playing and replaying. Test your skills and craft your perfect build to complete challenges, unlock difficulty modifiers and unlock new classes or cosmetics!

A Variety of Boss Battle to Test you Skill and Perks! Each with their own unique attacks and mechanics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: i7-9700K or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 - or equivalent with at least 8GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR. Quest; Rift, Rift S; Valve Index; WMR HP Reverb G2; HTC Vive and Vive Pro Supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required, VR Headset required. The native resolution and refresh rate of your VR headset will affect your performance.

Recommended:
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
